requirements.statement: Bind entry to PR 14 head, squash commit, tree, parent, exact-head CI, immutable artifact digests, and post-merge main CI.
Byte-verify protected Stage 5 authorities and every frozen v1 and accepted v2 schema.
Pass the complete accepted Stage 5 validator without changing its historical claims.
Publish one authoritative control-head update for the complete transaction and settlement batch or publish none.
Condition every publication on the exact expected prior head under a cross-process lock.
Durably order request, immutable objects, commit, authoritative head, and outcome publication.
Persist canonical content-addressed objects and reject non-identical reuse of any immutable path.
Verify content address, canonical encoding, frozen schema, self-digest, and commit inventory on every authoritative read.
Reject malformed, missing, noncanonical, or tampered requests, objects, commits, outcomes, and control heads.
Derive each proof identity from the exact frozen components and start each key at revision one.
Append exactly one proof revision per updated reconciliation key and bind every successor to its predecessor proof identity.
Never delete, replace, renumber, or detach a historical proof revision.
Open a stable exact-identity case at revision one for an exception proof and create no case for an initially matched proof.
Append OPEN case revisions for continuing exceptions and RESOLVED_BY_LATE_DATA revisions for later matches.
Bind every case revision to the current proof and exact predecessor while retaining the initial exception proof identity.
Classify persistence, conditional-write, integrity, and recovery failures as execution-owned failures.
Return authoritative_proof false and NO_AUTHORITATIVE_PARTIAL_PROOF for every finalization failure.
Preserve admission and financial rejection ownership without publishing a finalization head.
Make exact retries byte-idempotent and recover historical retries after later commits.
Reject attempt identity reuse with different inputs and reject a stale expected head without authority change.
Recover deterministically after real process termination at every boundary before and after head publication.
Allow exactly one winner among concurrent writers sharing an expected head and preserve a verifiable history.
Persist the complete admitted transaction and settlement state needed for deterministic later-batch replay.
Reconstruct policy, manifest, source, transaction, settlement, allocation, and replay state only from authoritative history.
Reject policy reuse, run reuse, source conflict, grain contamination, or removal of prior reconciliation history.
Keep production independent from the reference oracle, Spark, Parquet engines, network, AWS, and infrastructure clients.
Expose a local command that admits, reconciles, finalizes, recovers exact retries, and reports truthful failure ownership.
Perform no Spark execution, AWS call, workflow dispatch, infrastructure mutation, or managed persistence.
Pass full tests, 100 percent owned statement and branch coverage, all semantic mutations, deterministic wheel installation, and two clean Python 3.11.13 runs.
Require exact-head draft-PR CI, immutable evidence inspection, squash merge, and independent main CI before Stage 6 promotion.
